summary: The candidate reproduces and corrects the prior product-mismatch and startup code-revision counterexamples, and its focused and compatibility tests pass. It remains only a partial implementation of the upstream feature. Independent adversarial tests show that startup accepts a stale recorded driver because the current environment contains no driver-version field, and accepts a product-consistent CFG plan that is illegal for the exact workload because report selection performs no capability/signature legality validation.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before reproduction: the prepared base has no workload-signature advisor module.
The correction regression failed before the patch: 5 failed, 10 passed, including stale environment, impossible degree product, and startup revision/environment cases.
Independent adversarial contract tests: 2 failed, demonstrating acceptance of a stale driver record and a product-consistent but CFG-illegal plan.
Compatibility coverage: 199 passed and 67 subtests passed.

gpu_execution.evidence: One AMD Instinct MI350X was visible and runtime identity was queried, but no GPU numerical model execution was needed for the reproduced pure-Python resolver defects and no model weights were available.

remaining_counterexamples: A calibration report can contain a stale driver_version while all fields emitted by get_runtime_environment match; because current runtime identity has no driver-version field and comparison iterates only current keys, the stale report is selected.

A feasible exact-signature report with num_gpus=2 and cfg_parallel_size=2 is selected for a signature with cfg_branches=1. The product invariant passes, but startup does not validate the plan against workload/model/backend capabilities.
The original calibration command, isolated end-to-end benchmark protocol, model quality/trajectory execution, communication instrumentation, and calibrated benchmark matrix are not implemented.
The candidate adds no resolver routing to a compatible conservative pipeline recipe or existing auto_tune after calibration rejection beyond returning a conservative_fallback result.
No model-serving evidence demonstrates the requested world-size-one execution fast path; the candidate itself changes no distributed or model-wrapping implementation.
remaining_limitations: Only one MI350X was assigned, so multi-rank group initialization and topology behavior could not be executed.
No diffusion model weights or model-specific quality reference were available, so semantic accuracy, trajectory gates, and end-to-end calibration could not be verified.
No native source changed between the base and candidate, so a native rebuild was not applicable.
The runtime probe reported Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2, HIP 7.2.26015, device type cuda, distributed backend nccl, and AMD Instinct MI350X.
